turns.q: Can I change the payment method on my order?
turns.replyTail:
order has already been placed, the payment method cannot be changed. However, if this is about a subscription (Spar-Abo), you can update the payment method in your customer account:

Log in to your account and go to "Meine Spar-Abos."
Select the subscription you want to update by clicking "Mehr anzeigen."
Under "Zahlungsdaten," click "Anpassen" to update your payment method.
Confirm your changes by clicking "Karte aktualisieren."

If you need further help, let me know!
